current_diagnosis.summary: Enhance-security-info implementation is complete and verified.
points: SecurityRepoProcessor counts open Dependabot PRs in `dependabot_open_pull_requests`.
It counts ready Dependabot PRs in `dependabot_ready_pull_requests`.
Ready means not draft, not known unmergeable, commit status is successful, and all check runs are completed with `success`, `neutral`, or `skipped`.
Approval/review requirements are ignored for readiness.
PR list 403/404 sets both PR counts to `None`; non-fatal API errors produce partial results.
Per-PR readiness API errors exclude that PR from the ready count and produce a partial result.
Plain, table, and JSON security reports include the two new Dependabot PR counts.
Text report inclusion considers non-zero Dependabot PR counts.
Security progress messages report alert counts and Dependabot PR counts separately, because Dependabot PRs can overlap with the same underlying alerts.

requirements_summary.title: Enhance Security Info
requirements_summary.problem: The security scanner reports alert counts but did not show whether Dependabot already opened remediation PRs or whether those PRs are ready to merge once approval requirements are ignored.
requirements_summary.ready_definition: A Dependabot PR is ready when it is not draft, is not reported as unmergeable, has successful commit status, and all check runs are completed with `success`, `neutral`, or `skipped`. Requested reviewers and approval requirements are ignored.
requirements_summary.output: Plain, table, and JSON security reports include aggregate and per-repository Dependabot PR counts. Text reports display unavailable counts as `N/A`; JSON preserves them as `null`.
